lines.en: I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: I should leave Io alone for now...
lines.zh: 现在我该让 Io 一个人待着……

lines.en: if io_love >= 35 and iodorm35 == True and predormwars3 == True and ioarchery35 == False:
I tap on Io's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Io 的名字，等她接电话。
: 嘿！早上好，Sen——
: 哦，糟了。

lines.en: : I got too excited and might have woken Uta up.
lines.zh: : 我太兴奋了，好像把 Uta 吵醒了。
: 等等。

lines.en: A few seconds go by as Io presumably makes sure that her roommate is still asleep.
lines.zh: 过了几秒，Io 大概是在确认她室友还睡着。

lines.en: It's kind of cute that she'd get so excited by just a phone call-
lines.zh: 只是接到一个电话就这么兴奋，有点可爱——

lines.en: But the cuteness of that excitement quickly fades when I remember that she is just one of thirty-ish options, and that I could have just as easily called anyone else.
lines.zh: 但这份可爱很快就褪色了，因为我想到她只是三十来个选项里的一个，而我本来也可以轻轻松松打给任何别人。

lines.en: She can't be happy every morning.
lines.zh: 她不可能每个早上都开心。
: 好了。我回来了。
: 抱歉。

lines.en: : I went out into the hall and now I have to try and avoid confrontation with anyone else who happens to walk by.
lines.zh: : 我走到走廊里了，现在得想办法避开任何一个碰巧路过的人。

lines.en: : How about I make that a little easier by meeting up with you?
lines.zh: : 那不如我过来找你，让你省点事？
: 真的？现在？
: 这有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Not at all! I'm already dressed, so we can meet wherever really.
lines.zh: : 当然不介意！我都换好衣服了，哪里见都行。

lines.en: : I just didn't think you'd be up to hanging out so early in the day.
lines.zh: : 我只是没想到你一大早就愿意出来玩。
: 但我就是愿意啊。

lines.en: : Let's meet up near the bathhouse and just figure out what to do from there.
lines.zh: : 那就在澡堂附近见吧，到了再想干什么。
: 好啊！行！
: 待会儿见！

lines.en: Io and I make plans to get breakfast at a nearby convenience store, but...
lines.zh: 我和 Io 说好去附近的便利店吃早饭，可是……
: Io。

lines.en: : Are you eating a hot dog for breakfast?
lines.zh: : 你早饭在吃热狗？

lines.en: : I'm eating {i}three{/i} hot dogs for breakfast.
lines.zh: : 我早饭在吃{i}三根{/i}热狗。

lines.en: : This is just the first one.
lines.zh: : 这只是第一根。

lines.en: : There are a few more stores on this road and I have timed my hot dog consumption to end just as we make it to the each of them.
lines.zh: : 这条路上还有好几家店，我算好了吃热狗的节奏，正好每家店到的时候吃完一根。
: 这很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Well, whatever. You should get one too.
lines.zh: : 好吧，随便你。你也该来一根。

lines.en: : How exactly are you this skinny again?
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么做到还这么瘦的？
: 不知道。也许是间歇性断食？

lines.en: : I normally only eat like once or twice a day.
lines.zh: : 我平时一天也就吃一两顿。

lines.en: : But that's not important right now! It's hot dog time!
lines.zh: : 不过这不重要！现在是热狗时间！

lines.en: The rest of the morning goes by...strangely, I guess.
lines.zh: 剩下的早上就这么过去了……怎么说呢，挺奇怪的。

lines.en: But at least Io is happy.
lines.zh: 但至少 Io 很开心。
$ io_love += 1
{i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}
